enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Bend knees. Straighten legs. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow under head. Place arm under pillow. Remain still. Breathe deeply. Twitch leg. Roll onto back. Stretch arms. Yawn. Turn to left side again. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Morning wash, shower and teeth brushing
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up on bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Open bathroom door. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel around body. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Wipe mouth. Turn off water heater. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast, brewing coffee and packing a lunch box
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs and bread. Close refrigerator. Crack eggs into pan. Turn on stove. Fry eggs. Turn off stove. Place eggs on plate. Toast bread. Spread butter. Eat breakfast. Brew coffee. Drink coffee. Pack lunch box. Close lunch box. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Changing into work clothes and tidying the bedroom
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out clothes. Close wardrobe. Change into work clothes. Fold pajamas. Place in drawer. Make bed. Pick up clothes. Place in laundry basket. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Morning mobility and stretching routine while watching the news
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Turn on TV. Switch to news. Stand on mat. Raise arms. Stretch. Bend forward. Touch toes. Twist torso. Sit on floor. Reach for toes. Lie on back. Pedal legs. Stand up. Turn off TV. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Setting up the home workstation and reviewing the day's telehealth patient schedule
enriched_activities.desc: Enter study. Turn on light. Turn on computer. Adjust chair. Sit down. Open scheduling software. Review patient list. Check appointments. Print schedule. Write notes. Highlight appointments. Open patient files. Review notes. Stand up. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Working from home: conducting telehealth physiotherapy consultations and designing exercise programs
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open video app. Join patient call. Greet patient. Discuss symptoms. Demonstrate exercise. Observe patient. Correct posture. End call. Write notes. Open exercise software. Create program. Save. Join next call. Repeat. Take break. Stretch. Continue calls. Document. End session. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating lunch, washing up quickly
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out leftovers. Close refrigerator. Place in microwave. Start microwave. Heat food. Take out food. Place on plate. Eat lunch. Place plate in sink. Rinse plate. Apply soap. Scrub plate. Rinse plate. Place in rack. Wipe counter. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a short walk around the neighbourhood for fresh air and light exercise (walking, no EV used)
enriched_activities.desc: Open front door. Step outside. Close door. Walk down driveway. Walk around neighborhood. Return to house. Open front door. Step inside. Close door. Remove shoes. Place shoes on rack. Walk into living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Working from home: writing patient documentation, follow-up calls and reviewing rehabilitation plans
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open computer. Open patient records. Write progress notes. Save. Call patient. Discuss progress. End call. Write notes. Open rehab plan. Review exercises. Update plan. Save. Open email. Respond to messages. Write documentation. Review plans. End work. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing ingredients and having an afternoon snack
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and fruit. Close refrigerator. Chop vegetables. Place in bowl. Wash apple. Cut apple. Eat apple slices. Place vegetables in refrigerator. Wipe counter. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Resting on the sofa and checking the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open social media. Scroll feed. Like post. Open email. Read messages. Reply. Open news. Read headlines. Place phone down. Lean back. Rest. Pick up phone. Check weather. Place phone on table. Stand up. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out meat and vegetables. Close refrigerator. Cut meat. Cut vegetables. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Add oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Add sauce. Stir. Cover pan. Simmer. Turn off stove. Serve food on plate. Place plate on table. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at table. Pick up fork. Pick up knife. Cut food. Lift fork to mouth. Chew. Swallow. Repeat. Pick up glass. Drink water. Place glass on table. Continue eating. Finish meal. Pick up plate. Stand up. Walk to sink. Place plate in sink. Pick up glass. Place in sink. Pick up napkin. Wipe mouth. Throw napkin in trash. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Clearing the table, loading the dishwasher and tidying the kitchen
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up plates from table. Scrape food into trash. Place plates in dishwasher. Pick up glasses. Place in dishwasher. Pick up utensils. Place in dishwasher. Close dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher. Wipe table with cloth. Wipe counters. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and streaming shows to relax
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Turn on TV. Open streaming app. Select show. Play. Sit on sofa. Watch. Adjust volume. Pause. Get drink from kitchen. Return. Resume show. Watch. Finish episode. Turn off TV. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering, evening wash routine and starting a load of laundry
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Open washing machine. Place clothes in. Add detergent. Close. Start washing machine. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry with towel. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off water heater. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing a stretching and mobility session, then reading on the sofa
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Spread mat. Stand on mat. Raise arms. Stretch. Bend forward. Twist torso. Sit on mat. Reach for toes. Lie on back. Pedal legs. Stand up. Roll up mat. Pick up book. Sit on sofa. Read. Close book. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down, setting the alarm and preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Pick up phone. Open alarm app. Set alarm for 6:40. Place phone on nightstand. Remove clothes. Put on pajamas. Pull back blanket. Lie on bed. Adjust pillow. Pick up book. Read. Turn page. Read. Close book. Place book on nightstand. Turn off light. Close eyes. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Eyes closed. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Breathe deeply. Twitch leg. Roll onto back. Stretch arms. Yawn. Turn to left side again. Sleep.
